interfaces.what: LGA-16 body 4.5000 x 3.0000 mm, height 0.9500 +/- 0.050 mm overall with a 0.8200 +/- 0.030 mm step; 16 lands 0.1000 +/- 0.05 thick on a 0.5000 mm pitch, land field 3.8300 wide outer / 3.0000 inner, land rows at 1.1600 and 2.3300, pin 1 marked by a 0.075 x 0.300 corner feature. General tolerance, stated on the drawing: decimal +/- 0.05 unless otherwise specified. The frame is the package's geometric centre ON THE SEATING PLANE (z = 0 is the PCB land plane, +z into the body), which is the datum an SMT placement uses. `accepts` is EMPTY on purpose: an SMT land joint is connection:solder-smt, which is NOT on this shelf — naming it would dangle, and a dangling ref is a FAIL in bin/triad check, never a warning.
interfaces.source: READ OFF THE VENDOR'S OWN MECHANICAL DRAWING: Bosch Sensortec BMI088 data sheet, document BST-BMI088-DS000-19, Revision 1.9, 01/2024, section 8.1 'Outline Dimensions', Figure 10 'Package dimensions', PAGE 54 of 62 — the copy in this folder (current/datasheet.pdf, sha256 in current/PROVENANCE.json), read 2026-09-02 (lane T)
